name: Sar-sekim
overview: Sar-sekim was a male figure identified as the Rab-saris, which means chief official, during the time referenced in Jeremiah 39:3. familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record any family relationships for Sar-sekim beyond his designation as the Rab-saris. There are no known relatives or associates mentioned in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Sar-sekim's significance lies in his role as a chief official during a critical period in Israel's history, as recorded in Jeremiah 39:3. His presence in the narrative highlights the Babylonian leadership involved in the events surrounding Jerusalem's fall. Though details are sparse, his title underscores the administrative structure that played a part in God's judgment upon Judah.
